snippet.title: Touhou Heart of the Tiger Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download and play here: https://itch.io/jam/touhou-pride-4/rate/1597202

How does the highly revered Buddhist Monk Shou Toramaru spend her nights? ...By drinking at bars! Explore Shou's past and present as she helps different Touhou characters sort out their relationships in this visual novel (with minigames)! 

This was an all-star production, with many faces from the Touhou Community lending their talent to our Touhou Pride Jam 4 entry. I'm extremely happy with how this game ended up! Please check it out!

My Community Discord: https://discord.gg/PtUnYaHcD6

#Touhou #TouhouProject #Fangame #VisualNovel #TouhouJam
